_meta.description: Heating source parameter database for TEEI framework
_meta.note: Default values for Spain 2026. Country-specific prices loaded from countries.json.

electric.name: Electric resistance heater
electric.note: Converts ~99% of electrical energy to heat. T_source=500K (element surface).

gas.name: Gas stove / boiler
gas.note: 45% of gas energy reaches fluid. T_source=1200K (effective flame temp).

solar.name: Solar flat-plate thermal
solar.note: Price is amortised LCOE. Power calculated from area x irradiance x 0.65.

hp3.name: Heat pump COP 3
hp3.note: COP=3: delivers 3 kWh heat per 1 kWh electrical input. FTES uses Model B.

hp5.name: Heat pump COP 5
hp5.note: High-efficiency heat pump. FTES uses Model B.
